import.title: Import component TARA
import.intro: The component's DFD becomes the child page of a new multiprocess on this page; its threats, measures and assumptions come along. Choose the component's .tara.json.

error.invalid: The file is not a TARAflow project.
error.schema_too_new: The file was written by a newer TARAflow — update TARAflow first.
error.not_deterministic: The file was written by an old TARAflow. Open and save it in TARAflow 0.19 or later, commit it, then import it.
error.cycle: This TARA is the project itself or contains it — it cannot be imported.
error.no_dfd: The component TARA has no data flow diagram.

unpinned.no_repo: The file is not in a git repository.
unpinned.untracked: The file is not committed in its repository.
unpinned.consequence: The import is not pinned to a commit: only its content identifies the state, the machine keeps a warning until it is replaced by a committed state.

import.existingOther: This component is imported in another state ({{label}}). The new instance uses that state; moving all instances to a newer state comes with the update.
import.quantityHint: Identical units in the same place
import.existingSameContext: Identical units in the same installation context (same place, same connections): raise the quantity of the existing instance — one analysis for all of them.
import.existingOtherContext: Another place or other connections: add a further instance — its own child page and its own ratings.
import.unresolvable: These flows end on a boundary and will not resolve in the machine — draw them to the element inside the boundary in the component TARA:
import.name: Multiprocess name
import.noEntities: The component has no external entities.
import.newElement: Take over as a new element
import.applyFailed: The component could not be imported: {{message}}

findings.CMP_SOURCE_UNPINNED: Component {{component}} is imported unpinned ({{reason}}) — only its content identifies the state. Import a committed state for an audited TARA.
findings.CMP_INSTANCE_ORPHANED: Component instance {{prefix}} ({{component}}) has no multiprocess in the DFD — delete the instance or import the component again.
findings.CMP_FLOW_NOT_IN_COMPONENT: {{flow}} is attached to the imported component {{prefix}} ({{component}}) but is none of its interfaces — the component TARA does not cover it. Add the interface in the component TARA and update, or attach the flow elsewhere.
findings.CMP_COMPONENT_PAGE_CHANGED: The pages of component {{prefix}} ({{component}}) differ from the imported state: {{missing}} element(s) missing, {{added}} added. Component pages are read-only — the update restores them.
findings.CMP_METHOD_MISMATCH: Component {{component}} was rated with another likelihood methodology ({{method}}; this project: {{machineMethod}}) — only identical factors were taken over, rate the others in this project's method.
findings.CMP_FACTOR_UNRATED: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} imported risk(s) with likelihood factors still unrated.
findings.CMP_FACTOR_OVERRIDE_RATIONALE: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} risk(s) override a factor value taken over from the component without a rationale.
findings.CMP_NO_ATTACK_PATHS: Component {{component}} has no attack paths — in an ISO/SAE 21434 project only attack paths make risks, so it adds none. Model its attack trees in the component TARA.
findings.CMP_MEASURE_PENDING: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} imported risk(s) rely on component measures not implemented yet — they depend on a component release.
findings.CMP_HANDOVER_OPEN: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} risk(s) the component handed over or accepted arrive untreated — set this machine's treatment (an own measure, or accept / transfer with a justification).
findings.CMP_MEASURE_NOT_EFFECTIVE: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): measure(s) not effective in this instance — {{list}}: an assumption they rely on is not fulfilled here or invalid in the component.
findings.CMP_MEASURE_UNCLEAR: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): effectiveness of measure(s) unclear in this instance — {{list}}: an assumption they rely on is still open here.
findings.CMP_ACCEPTANCE_TO_REVIEW: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): acceptance to review — {{list}}: the residual risk is not credited, a component measure is not effective or unclear in this instance.
findings.CMP_AOU_OPEN: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} assumption(s) of use still open in this instance — check them in the multiprocess's details.
findings.CMP_AOU_VIOLATED: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): assumption(s) {{list}} not fulfilled — the component's analysis is not valid in this machine until resolved.
findings.CMP_AOU_MET_BY_PENDING: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{assumption}} is marked fulfilled by measure(s) {{measures}} of this machine that are not implemented yet.
findings.CMP_PATH_WINDOW_UNRATED: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} attack path(s) without this machine's window of opportunity — unrated, they make no risk. Rate them in the Attack Tree tab.
findings.CMP_PATH_NOT_RATABLE: Component {{prefix}} ({{component}}): {{count}} attack path(s) rated in quick mode — without the factor breakdown this machine cannot rate their window of opportunity, so they make no risk. Rate the paths in audit mode in the component TARA and update.

components.instanceRemoved: Component instance removed with its multiprocess: {{list}}

details.title: Imported component ({{prefix}}) — read-only
details.pathUnknown: Where the component TARA lies on this computer is not known — open it via File → Open.

copy.title: Copy ratings to {{prefix}}
copy.intro: Takes the ratings of another instance of the same component state over once. Afterwards both instances are independent — later changes are not carried over. Risk treatment stays per risk.
copy.decisions: Likelihood factors (context, overrides of prefilled factors), relevance overrides, window of opportunity, assumption status
copy.fill: Only fill what is not rated here yet
copy.done: Copied: {{factors}} factor rating(s), {{overrides}} relevance override(s), {{windows}} window(s) of opportunity, {{assumptions}} assumption status(es), {{impact}} asset impact rating(s).

assumptions.title: Assumptions of use ({{count}}) — open: {{open}}
assumptions.rationale: Why it does not apply here (required)

treatment.title: Treatment in the component ({{component}}): {{treatment}}
treatment.handoverOpen: The component handed this risk over or accepted it — it arrives untreated. Set this machine's treatment: an own measure, or accept / transfer with a justification.
treatment.handoverDecided: The component handed this risk over; this machine has set its own treatment.
treatment.pending: Measures not implemented yet depend on a component release.

threats.title: Threats from imported components ({{count}}) — read-only
threats.overriddenTooltip: Overridden by this machine ({{date}}): {{rationale}} — the component rated it {{component}}.
threats.toReview: to review — the component changed its decision
threats.overrideIntro: The component rated this threat on its boundary flow as “{{relevance}}” — without the machine context. Where the flow runs in this machine may change that. The rationale goes into the report (deviations from the component's assessment).

paths.title: Attack paths from imported components ({{count}}) — window of opportunity to rate: {{open}}
paths.intro: The window of opportunity depends on where the component sits in this machine — rate it per path. An unrated path has no feasibility and makes no risk; the component's value is a suggestion only.
paths.notRatable: quick mode — cannot be rated here
paths.adoptTitle: Take the component's value as this machine's rating
